description: Phase 3. Director recruits the Distributor per epoch after recovery completes (phase-a supervision ports: recruit-if-absent, halt registration losers, :normal DOWN = ceded no re-recruit, otherwise retry; epoch handed in). On start: take lock -> snapshot-read shard_keys/ + materializers/ under read-only lock check -> run; 5s read-only poll-to-die. Placeholder ports from phase-a (parking min(caller timeout, hold_ms), shed :unavailable, per-tag demand dedupe, drain on covered) with SETTLED addressing option 2: the placeholder IS a materializer ref - sweep publishes materializers/<tag> = {placeholder_worker_id, distributor_node} for uncovered tags via system-mode commit under check_lock; placeholder speaks the materializer read API; nothing changes at proxy or client. NO TSL deltas, NO pids in slots (see the phase-a must-not-port list).
title: Distributor singleton + placeholder-as-materializer-ref
